dialogue.content: おはようございます。本日はよろしくお願いいたします。朝からお受け下さりありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Good morning. Thank you for meeting with me today. I appreciate you making time for this so early in the morning.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you, I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: お願い致します。では、時間になりましたらはじめさせて頂きますね。
dialogue.English: Of course. We'll get started once it's time.

dialogue.content: 「時間ですので、はじめさせて頂きますね。」本日はご相談ありがとうございます。地域によっては、大雪で大変だったかと存じます。初めに、年齢と性別から教えていただいて宜しいでしょうか。
dialogue.English: 'It's time, so let's begin.' Thank you for your consultation today. I understand that some areas have been dealing with heavy snow, which must be challenging. First, may I ask your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 40歳女性です
dialogue.English: I'm a 40-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？お話できる範囲からで良いのでお話下さいね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to discuss today? Please feel free to share whatever you're comfortable with.

dialogue.content: 小学校4年生の子どもが不登校になり学校に行きたがらないので困っています
dialogue.English: My fourth-grade child has stopped attending school and doesn’t want to go, and I’m struggling with that.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それはお困りかとお察しいたします。お子様が行きたがらない理由はお分かりでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. That must be very difficult. Do you know why your child doesn’t want to go?

dialogue.content: 学校の先生が嫌いみたいですすぐ怒るのでやだって言っています
dialogue.English: They seem to dislike their teacher. They say they don’t like it because the teacher gets angry quickly.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、すぐ怒る先生は嫌ですね。お母さまはそのお子様の気持ちを聴いてどう思われました？
dialogue.English: I see... A teacher who gets angry easily would be unpleasant. How did you feel when you heard how your child feels?

dialogue.content: 先生変わらないかなと思います
dialogue.English: I just wish the teacher would change.

dialogue.content: 確かに、先生が変わると一番いいですね。その事をこちら以外でどなたかにご相談されましたか？
dialogue.English: Indeed, it would be best if the teacher changed. Have you discussed this with anyone else?

dialogue.content: 夫に相談しましたが自由にさせとけ、しかいいません
dialogue.English: I talked to my husband, but he just says, “Let them do as they like,” and that’s it.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ。自由にさせとけ、というのは行きたくないならそのままにしておけという事ですね？
dialogue.English: I see, I see. When he says to let them do as they please, does he mean to just let them stay home if they don't want to go?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: そうですか。それだと、奥様としては、どうしたら良いか更に悩みませんか？
dialogue.English: I see. In that case, doesn’t that leave you even more unsure about what to do?

dialogue.content: 悩んでいますね学校に行きたがらないので困っています原因もわかっていますので
dialogue.English: Yes, I’m struggling. They don’t want to go to school, and since I know the reason, it makes it all the more difficult.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ。本当にお悩みの中でご相談下さりありがとうございます。どうしたら良いのか、奥様のお気持ちを第一に考えながら、一緒に考えていきたいと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand. Thank you for consulting with me while you're going through such a difficult time. I'd like for us to think about what to do together, keeping your feelings as the top priority.

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: はい。所で、どうしたら良いか、ご自分でも今までいろいろ試してみましたか？
dialogue.English: Certainly. By the way, have you tried various things yourself to see what might help?

dialogue.content: 何もできませんね言葉で言うだけです
dialogue.English: I can't really do anything. I just talk to them.

dialogue.content: お声かけを頑張っておいでるのですね。教えて下さりありがとうございます。不登校はどの位つづいているのですか？
dialogue.English: You’ve been doing your best to talk with and encourage them, then. Thank you for sharing that. How long has the school refusal been going on?

dialogue.content: その先生になってからとか。
dialogue.English: For instance, has it been since they got this teacher?

dialogue.content: 昨日の9月頃からです最初は周に2～3日当たり
dialogue.English: Since around September of last year. At first, they were going about two to three days a week.

dialogue.content: 行っていました
dialogue.English: They were going.

dialogue.content: 半年くらいたつのですね。。今も週に2～3日くらいですか？
dialogue.English: So it's been about half a year... Are they still going about two or three days a week?

dialogue.content: 今年になり、全く行かなくなりました
dialogue.English: Since the start of this year, they've stopped going completely.

dialogue.content: 現在は不登校です
dialogue.English: Currently, they're not attending school at all.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ、完全に不登校なのですね。本当にお困りの中で何とかしようと悩まれてきたのですね。お母様としては、お子様がまた学校へ行ってくれるのが一番良いですか？
dialogue.English: I see—so it’s a complete school refusal now. You’ve been struggling all this time, trying to figure out what to do. As their mother, is your top priority for your child to go to school again?

dialogue.content: それとも、勉強をしてくれたら無理にとはという感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Or is it more that, as long as they’re studying, you wouldn’t want to force them to go?

dialogue.content: やはり学校には行って欲しいですね友達と遊んで欲しいですね
dialogue.English: I really do want them to go to school. I want them to play with their friends.

dialogue.content: ああ、そうですよね。勉強だけでなく、友達と遊んでコミュニケーションを深めてほしいという感じですかね。
dialogue.English: Ah, I understand. So it's not just about studying; you'd like them to play with friends and deepen their social skills, is that right?

dialogue.content: そうですねお友達を作って欲しい
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right. I want them to make friends.

dialogue.content: ですね。お母様のお気持ちは、親として当然だと思います。
dialogue.English: I agree. As a parent, your feelings are entirely natural.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、先生がすぐ怒るのは、単に性格からですかね？お子さまだけという事だとしたら、何か虐めの様な気もするのですが。。
dialogue.English: By the way, do you think the teacher’s quick temper is simply a matter of personality? If it were only directed at your child, it might feel like a form of bullying…

dialogue.content: 性格です
dialogue.English: It’s their personality.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。だとしたら、他の生徒さんにも同じ対応をしているという事ですね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. So that means they treat other students the same way.

dialogue.content: そうです耐えられる子どもと耐えられない子どもがいます家の子は耐えられないのです
dialogue.English: That's right. There are children who can tolerate it and those who can't. My child can't tolerate it.

dialogue.content: そんなすぐに怒るなら耐えられないのも無理ないと思います。耐えている子も限界を迎える寸前かも知れませんし。。少し、私が思った事をお話しても良いでしょうか？
dialogue.English: If the teacher gets angry that easily, I think it's understandable that your child can't tolerate it. The children who are enduring it might also be at their breaking point. May I share a thought that occurred to me?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 他の親御さんにも事情を説明して、他のお子様もどう思っているのか聞けるなら聞いた上で、学校へ陳情を出すというのは如何でしょうか？例えば、ＰＴＡを通じてとか、教育委員会でもいいですが。
dialogue.English: One idea is to explain the situation to other parents, ask—if possible—how their children feel as well, and then submit a petition to the school. For example, you could go through the PTA, or even the Board of Education.

dialogue.content: それか、先生へ直接お話するとか？先生がいるか、変わらない限り、どれだけお声かけしてもお子様が学校へ行くのは難しいと感じます。
dialogue.English: Or perhaps talking to the teacher directly? As long as this teacher is there and doesn't change, I feel it will be difficult for your child to go to school, no matter how much you encourage them.

dialogue.content: 事を大きくすると噂になります大丈夫ですあと、1か月で担任が変わるかもしれないのでそれにかけます
dialogue.English: Making a big deal out of it will just start rumors. It's okay. The homeroom teacher might change in a month, so I'm counting on that.

dialogue.content: 今日はこれで大丈夫です
dialogue.English: That’s all for today.

dialogue.content: 失礼してもいいですか？
dialogue.English: May I be excused?

dialogue.content: おお、そうでしたか。1ヶ月で変わるなら、それが一番良いですね。まだお時間がありますが、よろしかったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Oh, I see. If the teacher might change in a month, that would be best. We still have some time left; are you sure you’d like to end here?

dialogue.content: はい失礼します
dialogue.English: Yes, I'll be leaving now.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。失礼致します。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. Take care.

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました。すみません、評価でも良いのですが、何か改善点がありましたら、教えて頂けると幸いです。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you. A rating is fine, but I’d be grateful if you could let me know of any areas for improvement.)

dialogue.content: （すみません、まだ時間が残っていますが、ロールプレイを終了してもよろしいでしょうか？）
dialogue.English: (Excuse me, there is still time left, but is it alright if we end the role-play here?)

dialogue.content: （すみません、時間ですので、終了させて頂きますね。お疲れさまでした。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Excuse me, our time is up, so we'll end here. Thank you for your time and effort. Thank you very much.)
